We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps: likely (1) amide formation (carboxylic acid to amide), (2) Doebner modification to form the α,β-unsaturated acid (C=C with carboxylic acid), (3) sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). So retrosynthesis: target -> break amide to give carboxylic acid and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). Then break the α,β-unsaturated acid to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. So retro step: the unsaturated acid fragment (C=C/C(=O)N...) originates from aldehyde (maybe p-? Actually the unsaturated acid attached to phenyl sulfonyl group). The fragment is /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2. The α,β-unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl group via the double bond? Wait structure: ...c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So the phenyl sulfonyl attached to a phenyl ring (c2) which has a side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2. So the unsaturated acid is attached to the phenyl ring via the double bond (C=C). So Doebner modification would give that side chain from an aldehyde attached to that phenyl ring (i.e., the aldehyde is attached to the phenyl ring at that position). So retro: break the C=C double bond to give aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). Then the aldehyde is part of the phenyl ring (c2). So step 2: sulfonamide formation: the sulfonyl chloride (maybe p-toluenesulfonyl chloride?) Actually target has sulfonamide linking two phenyl rings: NS(=O)(=O)c2... So sulfonamide formed from amine (the tolyl amine) and sulfonyl chloride derived from the other phenyl sulfonyl chloride. The amine is the tolyl amine (para-methyl aniline) attached to sulfonyl group. So retro step: break sulfonamide to give p-toluidine (Cc1ccc(NH2)cc1) and sulfonyl chloride (ClS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(... )cc2). So overall three steps.

Thus we need to produce JSON route: root molecule target, child reaction 1 (amide formation) with template id for amide coupling (carboxylic acid + amine -> amide). Reaction 2 (Doebner modification) with template id for aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. Reaction 3 (sulfonamide formation) with template id for amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide.

We need template IDs. We can search for templates matching these transformations.

Search for amide formation (functional groups broken: carboxylic acid, formed: amide). Use functional_groups_broken ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"] maybe. Let's get available functional groups list.
